snippet.title: Falcon Patrol II – Commodore 64 Longplay | Classic Combat Flight Game
snippet.description:
Falcon Patrol II remix at @VargaNadin

Falcon Patrol II is a classic combat flight game released in 1984 for the Commodore 64, developed by Durell Software.

The game puts the player in control of a VTOL combat aircraft, flying low over hostile territory where fuel management, precise control, and constant enemy pressure are key to survival. Its smooth scrolling terrain and tactical gameplay made Falcon Patrol II one of the most memorable early action-flight games on the C64.

This video presents a full longplay of the original Commodore 64 version, recorded with no commentary, focusing purely on gameplay and the authentic C64 experience.

Credits

Developer: Durell Software
Design & Programming: Steve Lee
Platform: Commodore 64
Year: 1984
